title: Made a silent model-data gap visible
items: The NCAAF/NCAAM team-talent fix from earlier tonight tested correctly against a local key but is returning zero teams live in production — found by auditing real deployed data, not by re-testing locally. The code was silently treating "provider returned nothing" the same as "nothing to apply," so there was no trace of the gap anywhere. It now logs a clear diagnostic line instead, so this stops being invisible on future runs while the actual cause (a live-key/plan access question) gets sorted out.
